texts.html: I led UX and visual design to give a beloved ice‑cream shop a fun, low‑maintenance web presence, running rapid discovery, producing a playful one‑page layout with an updatable menu and Instagram integration, and ensuring responsive design; the site created a professional presence without upkeep overhead and supported a busy, growing shop.
